fonts.display: 'abcOracle', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif
fonts.body: 'gtPantheon', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif

palette.name: Void Black
palette.role: Page canvas, primary background — the dominant surface across all dark sections

palette.name: Carbon
palette.role: Elevated surface for nav borders, button outlines, and secondary structural elements against the black canvas

palette.name: Graphite
palette.role: Subtle raised surface for cards or containers sitting on the black canvas — the lightest neutral step before chromatic sections

palette.name: Frost
palette.role: Primary text, hairline borders on dark sections, and inverted backgrounds — the most-used color after black

palette.name: Ash
palette.role: Muted helper text, icon strokes, and secondary surface fills

palette.name: Smoke
palette.role: Medium-contrast borders, control outlines, and structural separators. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

palette.name: Slate
palette.role: Body text borders and the quietest readable gray — used where content recedes into the background

palette.name: Reactor Lime
palette.role: Primary action fill (CTA buttons), announcement bar background, and the sole warm accent — acid yellow-green against black creates instant focal hierarchy

palette.name: Plasma Blue
palette.role: Section background and chromatic border accent — vivid electric violet-blue that shifts the entire page into instrument-mode for feature blocks
